feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: COVID was allowed to spread with 'deadly speed' and failure on borders was 'missed opportunity'
articles.summary: A lack of testing left the government "effectively blind" to COVID spreading across the UK, a report has found.

articles.title: Boat found off Orkney where fishing boat carrying three men vanished
articles.summary: A partially sunken vessel has been found off the coast of Orkney, weeks after a fishing boat with three people onboard disappeared.

articles.title: Three men charged with murder of man in Greater Manchester
articles.summary: Three men have been charged with the murder of a man in Crumpsall in the north of Manchester.

articles.title: Hundreds of thousands of London transport users may have been hit by data breach
articles.summary: Oyster photocard customers may have had their account details compromised after "suspicious activity" was detected, Transport for London (TfL) said.

articles.title: Muslims projected to outnumber Christians worldwide by 2035
articles.summary: Islam is expected to surpass Christianity as the world's largest religion by 2035, according to detailed projections released on Wednesday.

articles.title: William and Kate meet India's PM as they wrap up royal visit
articles.summary: The Prince and Princess of Wales met the prime minister of India on Wednesday to discuss trade and bilateral ‌ties at the end of their three-day visit to the country.

articles.title: Woman, 19, dies after collision outside A&E
articles.summary: A 19-year-old woman has died after a road traffic collision outside an A&E in Wirral, police say.

articles.title: Actor Noel Clarke appears in court over alleged sexual offences
articles.summary: Actor Noel Clarke has appeared in court after being charged with alleged sexual offences against five women.

articles.title: Britain's biggest defence company to cut more than 1,000 jobs
articles.summary: British multinational aerospace, arms and information security company BAE Systems is to cut more than 1,000 jobs in its air division.
